items.q: How much does a custom app cost?
items.a: You don't fund one big development project upfront. You pay a monthly subscription that covers hosting, maintenance and updates. The app is then offered to other professionals in your trade: costs are shared, which is what keeps the price affordable.

items.q: I'm not technical. Is that a problem?
items.a: Quite the opposite: you know your trade, and that's all it takes. You walk me through your day-to-day and your current tools, I handle the tech and show you progress along the way.

items.q: Who do we work with for an app?
items.a: With Unirakun, our app development company: it designs, hosts and maintains your tool. You get a direct contact, me, and a company that keeps the app running over time.

A Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who also wears the product hat (CPO), working as a freelancer. You get the business vision, product roadmap and technical execution of a senior profile, without waiting for a full-time hire.

items.q: When should you bring me in?
items.a: When you need to launch an MVP, challenge an existing product, prepare an architecture to scale, bring generative AI into your product, or cover as interim CTO while you hire.

items.q: Where are you based? Do you work remotely?
items.a: I am based in Nantes, France, and work on site or remotely depending on your needs. I have worked with teams in Nantes, Paris and Niort.

TypeScript end to end: React on the frontend, Node.js on the backend, PostgreSQL or Supabase for data, and the cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) depending on your context. For AI: OpenAI, Claude, Mistral and RAG.
Send me a few lines about your context on LinkedIn or Malt. I'll get back to you to set up a first call and see together how I can help.
